description: Collect a finished campaign: the folder, its files, the written overview, and the path to the PDF. Takes the job_id from start_campaign, or the session_id from list_campaigns — use session_id for a campaign run in an earlier conversation, where no job id survives.

session_id.description: Campaign to collect, from list_campaigns. An alternative to job_id, not an addition: job_id wins when both are given.

name: get_pack
title: Get the finished pack
